title: Store Handover Standard: Damage Claim Timing and the Allowance on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
On a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, a damage claim registered while the pickup or delivery is still fresh raises the damage allowance through the report multiplier.

**Clause.** The report multiplier depends on when the damage claim was registered, in calendar days from the completed date: a claim registered on the completed date itself gives a report multiplier of 1.1; a claim registered on the next calendar day gives 1.05; otherwise the report multiplier is 1.

The damage allowance is multiplied by the report multiplier in the same product as the order total billed and the percentage at which the allowance is figured, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Terms used

- **The completed date** is the date of pickup or delivery shown on the order.
- **The damage claim** is the damage claim registered on the order; where there is more than one, the most recently registered one. Only its calendar date counts, not the hour.

## Day table (hypothetical completed date 12 August)

| Claim registered | Calendar days after the completed date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 12 August, any hour | 0 | 1.1 |
| 13 August, any hour | 1 | 1.05 |
| 14 August or later | 2 or more | 1 |

**Hypothetical figure.** An order total billed of 1800.00 at 15 percent gives 297.00 with a same-day claim and 283.50 with a next-day claim.
